title: Attracting Michigan preschoolers, teachers with free housing, other innovations
summary_en: A shortage of early childhood educators and the lack of child care options in some areas have inspired innovative solutions in Michigan. They include a free housing program in Battle Creek and converting space in a Grand Rapids transit facility into a child-care center.
author: Martin Slagter, Chalkbeat
